notes: The cartridge's own RTTI names this class daObjMcWater_c: _ZTS at ov009:0x021139e0 spells "14daObjMcWater_c", and _ZTI at 0x021139d4 is an __si_class_type_info whose +8 word points at _ZTI10dBgActor_c (ov002:0x021089ec), so dBgActor_c is the direct and only base. The coined CastleWater alias that used to sit on this vtable has been removed from config/arm9/overlays/ov009/symbols.txt.

The destructor is declared FIRST and INLINE in include/daObjMcWater_c.h. Out of line, mwccarm emits D0 ahead of D1 (the cartridge has D1 first, at 0x02111a70) and also emits the D2 base-object variant the ROM never carried; declaring it first is also what makes this TU the vtable's home, so _ZTV and the RTTI pair land here.

daObjMcWater_c_classInit stores (int)&_ZTV14daObjMcWater_c[2], not the bare symbol. Because this TU emits the vtable rather than importing it, _ZTV names the emitted OBJECT -- the two-word Itanium preamble at ov009:0x02113a10 -- and the [2] steps over it onto the address point at 0x02113a18 that the cartridge's literal-pool word at 0x02111dc0 actually holds.
The factory's ROM-era name was CastleWater_Spawn; it is spelled daObjMcWater_c_classInit here, matching its ov009 neighbour daObjMc_Metalnet_c_classInit.

func_ov009_02111b1c stays a C-linkage free function taking char*. The cartridge gives it a global symbol that other config still names, and it is called with `this` from InitResources; promoting it to a member is a separate change with its own codegen risk.

data_0209caa0 carried two conflicting legacy spellings (bare int vs a three-int record). The record wins in this TU and InitResources reaches the same word through the byte offset its own matched body already spelled, which is why the tubuild create conflict note is resolved rather than carried.

LEFTOVER CLEANUP. SUPERSEDES the factory / char* helper / data_0209caa0 notes above. classInit is now `return new daObjMcWater_c()` with a leaf `operator new(unsigned long)` forwarding `_ZN7fBase_cnwEj((unsigned)size)`. `virtual ~daObjMcWater_c() {}` is inline and first among virtuals, so mwccarm emits the retail D1-then-D0 pair and no leaf D2; InitResources is the key function and still homes _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS here (deadstrip-data, same 11 records). The inline chain also emits a homeless `_ZN10dBgActor_cD2Ev`, licensed deadstrip below -- the same helper ov016/daObjKi_Ita_c and ov029/daObjWc_Mizu_c record. Named-field substitutions in Init/Behavior/Render/Cleanup/func_ov009_02111b1c MATCH. func_ov009_02111b1c stays C-linkage (cartridge global); it now takes daObjMcWater_c* and uses mPosX / mAreaId.

Static initializer folded: the model and collision handles (ids 0x693/0x694) and the three seven-entry Vector3 spawn tables are real definitions in d_a_obj_mc_water.cpp, replacing the handwritten src/unnamed/ov009/__sinit_ov009_02112524.c. mwcc emits __sinit_d_a_obj_mc_water.cpp (0x538), its .ctor word and the twenty-three registration nodes itself; all are byte- and relocation-identical to retail. Ownership: ov009 .init, .ctor and .bss run in .text TU order; this TU's .bss 0x02113c68..0x02113e88 sits between d_a_obj_dk_pole's (ending 0x02113c68) and d_a_obj_mc_metalnet's (from 0x02113e88), and func_ov009_02111b1c in this TU is the only .text that reads the tables. Interior element addresses that dsd names by their own labels are recorded as table + offset, as mwcc emits them.

ACTOR CLEANUP (1028). SUPERSEDES the C-linkage notes above: func_ov009_02111b1c is now the member daObjMcWater_c::SpawnWaterfalls(), byte-identical, called as SpawnWaterfalls() from InitResources. The dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile call is spelled as a plain member call on mMeshCollider. The TU's @NNN uniquifiers shifted by one; defined_symbol_renames were re-keyed by __sinit relocation-site order.
